title: 30-Minute Guard Workout
description: A complete guard session: ball handling, change of pace, pick-and-roll reads, pull-up shooting, and finishing — built for lead guards and wings.

items.name: Two-ball warm-up
items.detail: Simultaneous pound dribbles 30s, alternating 30s, one-high-one-low 30s each side. Eyes up.

items.name: Cone move series
items.detail: 4 cones, 10 feet apart: crossover, between-the-legs, behind-the-back, combo round — explode out of every move.

items.name: Change-of-pace attacks
items.detail: Hesitation and go: slow-to-explosive drives from the wing to the rim, 5 each side. Sell the slow.

items.name: Pick-and-roll reads
items.detail: Use a chair as the screener: come off the screen and make the read — shoot, pocket pass, or reject. 10 reps.

items.name: Pull-up jumpers
items.detail: One-dribble and two-dribble pull-ups from the elbows and wings: 3 makes per spot.

items.name: Finishing circuit
items.detail: Full-court drives: euro step, pro hop, reverse — 3 makes of each, full speed.

items.name: Free-throw finish
items.detail: 10 free throws with your routine to close. 8+ makes is the standard.

tips: Guards live on change of pace — every drive in this workout should have a clear slow-to-fast rhythm.
Treat the chair screen seriously: set up the defender, use the screen, then read.
Finish every shooting block with free throws to train focus when fatigued.
Log your makes per block so next week's workout has a target to beat.
